assumptions_patch.scenario: Stationary INR reference (not an issuer forecast)
assumptions_patch.story_text:
Stationary INR reference scenario only, not an issuer forecast. No per-share valuation approved. Scenario receipt: docs/workstreams/evidence/W2/financial-20261102/india/scenario-candidates.json (SHA-256 4a31dacec2caa470c4d736f3d93b428fe6fe312b12f0aa94d186722a689e7c4b). 
Scenario: An assets-in-place stationary reference, intentionally not the company base forecast or current equity valuation. This is the defensible closed-form reference when evidence does not support organic growth or competitive-advantage duration. Do not retain the Base label.
Growth and horizon: Ten explicit relative years, 0% nominal revenue growth throughout and 0% perpetual growth. This eliminates unsupported extrapolation of historical growth and acquisition effects; it is not a claim the company will stop growing. Horizon length is a display convention here because the stationary terminal carries the same economics.
Margin: Hold the independently reviewed reported operating margin, including the reported exceptional cost burden. Do not assume exceptional charges disappear or lift the target to an industry average. This is a deliberately conservative reference, not normalized expected earnings.
Capital: Explicit historical operating-capital proxy = consolidated equity including NCI + reviewed debt carrying proxy + lease liabilities - cash - investment carrying proxy. No claim this is independently measured economic capital. Investment/current claim scope limitations in the historical packet continue to apply.
Capital efficiency: Sales-to-capital is revenue / that defined capital proxy. This calibrates a reference denominator; zero forecast growth makes net reinvestment zero. It is not a sourced incremental project-return estimate.
Lease policy: Retain already capitalized IFRS/Ind AS lease debt separately in the equity bridge, and retain ROU depreciation in reported EBIT. Do not add back a complete rent expense or subtract the same lease principal twice. The stationary scenario explicitly assumes gross maintenance/replacement spending, including replacement ROU rights and working-capital maintenance, equals the corresponding depreciation/amortization so net reinvestment is zero. This is a sensitivity assumption, not evidence of actual maintenance requirements. No FCFE input is manufactured.
Tax: 25% is a rounded scenario cash-tax burden, not an asserted statutory/marginal rate or a prediction that historical tax credits recur. The statement evidence is context only: Reliance reported group tax 27,552 / pretax 123,162; Airtel 113,499 / 451,727, with exceptional tax effects separately disclosed. A full expected-tax forecast remains unsupported.
Currency hurdle: Use a fixed 14% annual nominal INR reference hurdle for both early and terminal periods. This is a discretionary scenario requirement, not an observed issuer WACC or a recommendation. Context: pinned January 2026 INR risk-free proxy 6.4853658537% plus the workbook Global ERP input 7.08% is about 13.5654%; 14% is a rounded reference with no claimed issuer-risk calibration. The workbook ERP is not approved as India/Africa country risk.
Risk inputs: Clear beta, ERP, issuer cost of equity/debt and market leverage weights because no reliable issuer-weighted business/geographic/leverage basis is established. Their review is concluded as unavailable, not waiting for routine user approval. The 14% hurdle remains explicit; do not reconstruct an issuer WACC or financing sensitivities from null component defaults.
Terminal: Set g=0 and terminal ROIC=14% as a no-excess-return terminal convention. With g=0, terminal reinvestment is exactly zero and ROIC does not change terminal cash flow. This does not claim current or future realized ROIC equals 14%.
Use boundary: Candidate may be applied only to an unpromoted reviewed research draft, after current version/source checks and preserving prior manual edits. It must remain named and described as a stationary reference. Annual-report date is the source basis, not a current valuation date. No current share-price gap or per-share result until rejected claim/denominator inputs are genuinely resolved.
